name: How do I maintain my stucco textured walls?

mainEntity.name: How do I maintain my stucco textured walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining stucco textured walls involves regular cleaning and occasional inspections. Typically, a gentle rinse with a garden hose can remove surface dirt. For tougher grime, use a soft brush and a mild detergent solution, rinsing thoroughly afterward. Avoid high-pressure washers, which can damage the stucco. Inspect your walls annually for hairline cracks or chipping, especially after significant weather events. Promptly address any damage to prevent moisture intrusion and larger issues, preserving the integrity and appearance of your stucco.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintain stucco by regularly rinsing with a hose and using mild detergent for deeper cleaning, avoiding high pressure, and inspecting for cracks.
